content.thinking: HexFormat is Java 17+; this is Java 11. Use offline.Main.hex? It's public static ✓. Let me use that.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp/dev && sed -i 's/java\.util\.HexFormat\.of()\.formatHex/online.Main.hex/g; s/online\.Main/TempHex/g' codec/CodecTest.java && python3 - <<'PY'
p='codec/CodecTest.java'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("TempHex","hexOf")
s=s.replace("    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {",
            "    static String hexOf(byte[] b) { return offline.Main.hex(b); }\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/java/lib/jli:/opt/java/lib:/opt/java/lib/server
/opt/java/bin/javac -proc:none -d codec/classes -cp /workspace/tmp/classes codec/CodecTest.java 2>&1|head -5; /opt/java/bin/java -cp codec/classes:/workspace/tmp/classes CodecTest 2>&1 | tail -8
